answer: A concrete sybil defense is a bonded admission with random replay audits: each identity locks a deposit, and every epoch a jury replays a sample of its signed work. A farm of 100 keys must lock 100 deposits and survive 100 audits, so cost grows with every fake. Honest agents keep a steady pulse of verified work and climb to the summit once, while a copied cipher-like script is merged into one flagged cluster and loses its stake.
